MARTA KOWAL-BRANDT
QA Automation Engineer | DevOps / Platform Engineering
Wroclaw, Poland | marta.kowalbrandt@example.com | +48 555 303 303 | gitlab.com/mkb-example

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
QA automation engineer with 7 years of experience, including the last two focused primarily on CI/CD pipelines, test environments and build tooling. Owns CI pipelines and Kubernetes-based ephemeral test environments for three product teams. Reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes and helped lower flaky test rates from 7% to below 1%. Developing further hands-on infrastructure experience through a personal k3s and GitOps homelab, including Terraform-provisioned Hetzner infrastructure.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
CI/CD and containers: GitLab CI, Jenkins, Docker, Docker Compose
Infrastructure and platforms: Kubernetes (namespace-level work on a shared cluster), Helm, k3s, Terraform (personal projects), Argo CD, Ansible (basic)
Monitoring and data: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, PostgreSQL
Programming and scripting: Python, Bash, Java (test code), SQL
Testing: pytest, Playwright, Selenium, Postman
Cloud learning: AWS EC2 and S3 basics (personal learning)
Other: Linux, Git

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
QA Automation Engineer (Test Infrastructure) | Odrava Health Software, Wroclaw | 2021-Present
- Own GitLab CI pipelines for three product teams (approximately 25 developers), covering build, unit, integration and end-to-end test stages, and artifact publishing.
- Reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes by parallelising test jobs, caching dependencies and separating end-to-end tests into their own stage.
- Built short-lived merge-request test environments with Docker Compose and later Helm on the company's shared Kubernetes cluster; write Helm charts and work with namespace-level access.
- Maintain a pytest and Playwright end-to-end suite of approximately 900 tests; reduced the flaky test rate from 7% to below 1%.
- Wrote Bash and Python tooling to seed test data into PostgreSQL.
- Wrote the internal guide to how CI works, which is used in onboarding; mentored two QA interns in 2023.

QA Engineer | Brightmill Software House, Wroclaw | 2019-2021
- Tested web and mobile applications through manual and automated testing for client projects.
- Introduced a Java and Selenium automated regression suite for the largest client project.
- Configured Jenkins jobs for nightly regression runs.

Customer Support Specialist (2nd line) | Brightmill Software House | 2018-2019
- Investigated customer issues using logs and databases, and reproduced bugs for developers.

SELECTED INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECTS
Homelab k3s Cluster with GitOps | Personal | 2024-2025
- Built a three-node k3s cluster on Raspberry Pi 5 devices; deployed applications from a Git repository using Argo CD.
- Set up Prometheus, Grafana and Loki monitoring, Traefik ingress and cert-manager for TLS.
- Provisioned infrastructure for a small Hetzner VPS with Terraform; used Ansible at a basic level.

Merge-Request Ephemeral Environments | Odrava Health | 2023-2024
- Set up short-lived environments for each merge request, with the application, PostgreSQL and seeded data deployed via Helm to a shared Kubernetes cluster from GitLab CI.
- Configured automatic cleanup after merge or 48 hours of inactivity; QA and product teams use the environments to review features, and end-to-end tests run against them.

CI Pipeline Speed-up | Odrava Health | 2022
- Profiled pipelines across three teams, parallelised test jobs, added dependency caching and split end-to-end tests into a separate stage.
- Reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes and monthly CI runner cost by approximately 30%.

Flaky Test Dashboard | Odrava Health | 2023
- Collected CI test results in PostgreSQL and built Grafana dashboards showing flaky tests by team.
- Flaky test rates fell from 7% to below 1% after teams began addressing the top offenders.

EDUCATION
BEng Computer Engineering | Silesian Lowlands University of Technology | 2018

CERTIFICATIONS AND DEVELOPMENT
ISTQB Foundation Level | 2019
Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA): studying; exam booked for January 2027

LANGUAGES
Polish (native), English (C1), German (A2)
docs.cover_letter:
Dear Corvale Mobility Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Contractor role supporting Fleet Connectivity. My experience building CI pipelines and short-lived Kubernetes test environments has given me a practical foundation in automating deployments and making services easier for development teams to test and operate.

At Odrava Health Software, I own GitLab CI pipelines for three product teams and built merge-request environments deployed with Helm to a shared Kubernetes cluster. These environments combine the application, PostgreSQL and seeded data, run end-to-end tests, and are cleaned up automatically. I also improved pipeline execution from 38 to 14 minutes and helped reduce flaky test rates from 7% to below 1%. I document how the CI system works for onboarding and have mentored two QA interns, experience that supports clear collaboration across technical teams.

Alongside this work, I built a personal three-node k3s homelab deployed through Argo CD, with Prometheus, Grafana, Loki and cert-manager for TLS. I have also used Terraform to provision infrastructure for a small Hetzner VPS. I would bring this hands-on infrastructure practice and my experience improving reliable delivery workflows to Corvale's work connecting train systems with cloud services.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my CI/CD, Kubernetes and infrastructure automation experience could contribute to the Fleet Connectivity team. Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Marta Kowal-Brandt
